workstreams.title: Unified intelligence router
workstreams.implemented: Local command, preference, repeat and correction routing; capability-management boundaries; local error follow-ups. Bounded per-chat conversation context and local plan follow-ups.
workstreams.remaining: Broader action coverage, voice/live-chat routing parity and ambiguous multi-action handling.

workstreams.title: AI and learning settings
workstreams.implemented: Learning controls, preferences, targeted forget/reset, capability-request commands and My voice profile calibration. Focused Appearance and Intelligence category menus.
workstreams.remaining: Complete capability lifecycle controls and phone checks for voice calibration.

workstreams.title: Verified learning loop
workstreams.implemented: Volume, app and timer aliases, outcome feedback, offline reuse and proposal edits. Saved-request alias teaching is implemented.
workstreams.remaining: Broader action learning and generalization; saved-request alias phone verification remains pending.

workstreams.title: AI capability builder
workstreams.implemented: Approved routines use existing handlers. Requests can be captured, assessed, selected by number and staged for a supported-action trial. Timer/app and exact-volume trials retain request identity and display linked outcomes with fresh target comparison. Volume uses Android readback; timer/app outcomes use user feedback.
workstreams.remaining: Arbitrary feature-code generation, sandbox evaluation and builder-driven deployment are not operational.

workstreams.title: Intelligence dashboard
workstreams.implemented: Inventory, command/memory/routine review, outcome journal, diagnostics and capability-discovery review through chat. In-app progress report, cached offline and refreshed separately from APK updates.
workstreams.remaining: Complete capability lifecycle management and integrated update approval.

workstreams.title: AI provider integration
workstreams.implemented: Gemini and search routing; local failure explanations and repair follow-ups that can answer while Gemini is unavailable.
workstreams.remaining: Provider parity, outage recovery and offline generative AI. HTTP 503 availability remains provider-controlled.

workstreams.title: Secure updates and rollback
workstreams.implemented: Repeatable CI, unit checks, permanent-key signing, in-app update packages and direct APK delivery.
workstreams.remaining: Builder-driven approval/deployment and rollback recovery are not fully integrated or phone-verified.

note: Engineering scope estimate with seven equally weighted workstreams. Percentages are not an accuracy score or proof of device verification. A newer plan may describe a release newer than the installed app.
milestone: Edited timer trial and request review were phone-confirmed in 3.5.388. Linked volume reviews and refined menu navigation await phone verification. In-app plan, menu refinements and chat context require phone review after this update; estimates stay unchanged.
